note: The battle screen's own controls (ui/play/battle_speed.gd, ally_orders.gd; checked by tools/check_data.gd). Rendering only: nothing here reaches the rules, the dice or the typed events of a fight. 'speed' is how long the SCREEN takes: the speed steps, how far each shrinks the hit-stop and the shake, the event pacing and the words of the controls. 'orders' are the companions' one-tap buttons: the word and 8x8 pixel glyph of each ('#' drawn, '.' clear) and the words of the row.

text.speed_tip: How fast the fight plays on screen: 1x, 2x or 4x. Only the waiting and the animations change; the dice and the result are the same. Key: {key}.
text.skip_tip: Skip animations: each round shows only its result and the log. The result is the same as when it is played out. Key: {key}.
text.forward_tip: Auto-battle at {n}x speed. Press again to go back to 1x.

tips.skill_none: {name} has no skill to use now.
tips.auto: {name} fights on their own, choosing as the autopilot would.

text.title: Orders
text.all_auto_tip: Every companion fights on their own, choosing as the autopilot would. Press again to give the orders yourself.
text.focus_tip: Pick a foe, then press this: every companion on Auto or Attack goes for it, round after round, until it falls. Press again to let go.
